items.text: Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle would not work correctly.
Added support for mounting Gen2 AI creatures via a new NPCMountable component (mounts instantly without frame reposition).

2026-09-14.summary:
### Animals & Mounting
- Fixed issue where multiple animals near a vehicle would not work correctly.
- Added support for mounting Gen2 AI creatures via a new NPCMountable component (mounts instantly without frame reposition).

items.text: Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.
Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.
Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.
Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.

2026-09-13.summary:
### Animals & Resources
- Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.

### Weapons
- Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.

### Bug Fixes
- Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.

items.text: Fixed status info not rendering on Windows host consoles.

2026-09-12.summary:
### UI & HUD
- Fixed status info not rendering on Windows host consoles.
